repositories.name: rea
repositories.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repositories.summary: REA 是一个基于 MCP 的逆向工程工具，让 AI 代理分析二进制、应用与运行时行为，并给出带证据的代码追踪结果。

repositories.name: AnyPS5
repositories.description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
repositories.summary: AnyPS5 是一个用 C++ 编写的工具，可将 PS5 可执行文件自动移植到 Linux 和 Windows，通过重链接和系统库实现原生运行，而非模拟。

repositories.name: artcraft
repositories.description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
repositories.summary: ArtCraft 是一个用 Rust 开发的交互式 AI 图像与视频创作 IDE，支持 2D 构图、3D 场景搭建和模型选择，帮助艺术家精确控制生成结果。

repositories.name: diagram-design
repositories.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repositories.summary: 这是一个面向多种 AI 编程助手的技能，用自然语言描述即可生成自包含 HTML 与 SVG 的编辑风格图表，内置 44 种图表类型，并可按品牌配色和字体定制。

repositories.name: context-mode
repositories.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
repositories.summary: Context Mode 是一个面向 AI 编程代理的 MCP 服务器，通过沙箱隔离工具输出、持久化会话记忆和路由规则来优化上下文窗口占用。

repositories.name: skills
repositories.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repositories.summary: 这是一套面向真实软件工程的 AI 编码代理技能集合，用于规范开发流程、减少代理啰嗦与错误，帮助开发者按工程实践完成代码修改。

repositories.name: flutter
repositories.description: Flutter makes it easy and fast to build beautiful apps for mobile and beyond
repositories.summary: Flutter 是谷歌推出的开源 SDK，用单一 Dart 代码库为移动、Web 和桌面构建高性能、界面精美的应用。

repositories.name: tensorflow
repositories.description: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone
repositories.summary: TensorFlow 是端到端开源机器学习平台，提供工具、库与社区资源，供研究者推进机器学习前沿，也便于开发者构建和部署机器学习应用。

repositories.name: ppt-master
repositories.description: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He
repositories.summary: PPT Master 是一个 Python 工具，让 AI 根据文档或主题生成原生 PowerPoint 演示文稿，支持原生形状、动画、图表表格、语音旁白和自定义模板。

repositories.name: pytorch
repositories.description: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration
repositories.summary: PyTorch 是一个 Python 深度学习框架，提供支持 GPU 加速的张量计算和基于磁带式自动微分的动态神经网络。

repositories.name: transformers
repositories.description: 🤗 Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, vision, audio, and multimodal models, for both inference and training.
repositories.summary: Hugging Face Transformers 是一个基于 Python 的模型定义框架，提供文本、视觉、音频和多模态的先进机器学习模型，支持推理与训练。

repositories.name: knowledge-work-plugins
repositories.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
repositories.summary: 这是 Anthropic 开源的知识工作插件集合，为 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 提供面向销售、数据等岗位的专用技能与命令。

repositories.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
repositories.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
repositories.summary: 这是一个 CLAUDE.md 配置文件，用于约束 Claude Code 的编码行为，依据 Andrej Karpathy 对 LLM 编码缺陷的观察，提出四条原则以减少错误假设和过度改动。
